title: Thread-Safe Collections: Blocking Queues and Concurrent Maps
title_es: Colecciones Thread-Safe: Blocking Queues y Concurrent Maps
description: Runnable examples of blocking queues, concurrent maps, thread-safe queues, copy-on-write lists, and atomic counters in Java, Python, and C++.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables de colas bloqueantes, mapas concurrentes, colas seguras entre hilos, listas copy-on-write y contadores atómicos en Java, Python y C++.
